qa.topFinding: All 11 MCP packages + trigger-matcher have tests. 1,327 total tests (1,127 MCP + 200 trigger-matcher). Coverage reporting enabled in all packages. mcp-shared at 88.7% statement coverage with thresholds enforced. 7 test suites in mcp-shared alone (64 tests).
qa.recommendation: Add integration tests for cross-server scenarios, raise coverage thresholds as test coverage improves
qa.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - all components have unit tests with coverage tracking

uiux.topFinding: PM dashboard (TUI + web) has dark/light theme toggle (persisted in localStorage), keyboard navigation (J/K section nav, T theme toggle, R refresh, ? help), ARIA-friendly focusable cards. Multi-project view also themed. Primarily a CLI toolkit, so UI needs are limited.
uiux.recommendation: Add collapsible sections and responsive mobile layout improvements
uiux.riskIfIgnored: Low risk - UI is secondary to this project's purpose

security.topFinding: All 45 sanitizePath() calls now include basePath=process.cwd() preventing path traversal. CI secrets scan fails build on findings. execFile() everywhere (no shell injection). npm audit fails on high-severity vulns.
security.recommendation: Add SQL injection protection to database-operations, add Content-Security-Policy headers if web dashboard is exposed
security.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - major attack vectors are closed

devops.topFinding: CI tests all 10 MCP servers + mcp-shared + trigger-matcher. ESLint zero-tolerance. Secrets scan fails build. npm audit enforced. Coverage reporting in all packages. Pre-commit hooks via husky + lint-staged. Only gap: no required status checks on GitHub (needs admin access).
devops.recommendation: Enable required status checks on main branch (requires repo admin), add coverage summary to CI output
devops.riskIfIgnored: CI failures can still be merged without branch protection (GitHub admin setting)

networking.topFinding: Stdio transport (minimal exposure). runServer() provides health check framework for all servers. rag-mcp, code-review-mcp, and testing-mcp all use startup health checks via commandHealthCheck(). checkCommand utility verifies CLI tool availability at startup. URL sanitization blocks SSRF.
networking.recommendation: Add periodic health checks for long-running servers, consider health check endpoint for external monitoring
networking.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - all exec-based servers now verify tool availability at startup

development.topFinding: ESLint zero-tolerance (all errors, --max-warnings 0). All 12 components have tests (1,305 total). Proper TypeScript types everywhere (no 'any'). Pre-commit hooks via husky + lint-staged. Coverage reporting enabled. Root-level test-all.mjs script.
development.recommendation: Add type checking (tsc --noEmit) to pre-commit hooks, add integration test suite
development.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive development guardrails in place

architecture.topFinding: All 10 servers use runServer() factory from mcp-shared - zero duplicated boilerplate. Clean separation: schemas/helpers at module level, handlers in callback. mcp-shared has 7 modules (server, logger, sanitize, response, health, metrics, check-command). No monorepo/workspaces yet.
architecture.recommendation: Set up npm workspaces for dependency sharing, create tsconfig.base.json to eliminate 11 duplicate configs
architecture.riskIfIgnored: 11 separate npm installs is slow; duplicate tsconfig may drift

product.topFinding: Comprehensive feature coverage: 47 agents (7 now with v2.1.49 features: background, memory, isolation), 19 skills (new /update-check), 10 MCP servers, install manifest tracking, version sync tooling. Clear purpose and value proposition.
product.recommendation: Keep docs in sync with Claude Code CLI releases
product.riskIfIgnored: Users follow outdated guides as CLI evolves

api.topFinding: MCP tool interfaces are consistent. All use Zod validation, shared errorResponse() with actionable context. Standard response helpers from mcp-shared. runServer() provides unified lifecycle.
api.recommendation: Add input examples to tool descriptions for better discoverability
api.riskIfIgnored: Users may not understand expected input formats

monitoring.topFinding: 100% instrumentation. Log rotation via MCP_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB (default 10MB) with lazy size checking (every 100 writes). MetricsCollector tracks per-tool p50/p95/p99 latencies with 1000-entry cap per tool. MCP_LOG_FILE for persistent output. All servers log requestId + durationMs. Startup time tracked via startupMs in server logs.
monitoring.recommendation: Wire MetricsCollector.recordCall() into server tool handlers for automated latency tracking, add metrics export endpoint
monitoring.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - log rotation prevents unbounded growth, metrics infrastructure ready for integration

database.topFinding: rag-mcp healthCheck() wired into runServer() startup with retry logic. Adapter pattern supports ChromaDB, Qdrant, Redis. Graceful degradation on failure.
database.recommendation: Add periodic health checks and connection pool monitoring
database.riskIfIgnored: Post-startup connection drops still need manual detection

performance.topFinding: CI benchmark results persisted as JSON artifacts (90-day retention) with per-server build times, commit SHA, timestamps. 120s total build time SLA warning enforced. Startup time (startupMs) automatically logged by runServer(). MetricsCollector enables per-tool p50/p95/p99 latency tracking.
performance.recommendation: Add benchmark comparison step that downloads previous artifact for trend detection, wire MetricsCollector into tool handlers
performance.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - benchmark data now persisted for trend analysis

documentation.topFinding: Excellent documentation: comprehensive README, QUICKSTART, complete guides, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG. mcp-shared lacks its own API documentation.
documentation.recommendation: Add mcp-shared API docs and usage examples
documentation.riskIfIgnored: New contributors won't know how to use shared library

specifications.topFinding: Good informal specifications via CLAUDE.md (comprehensive project instructions), README.md, QUICKSTART.md, and per-server READMEs. TOOLS-INDEX.md catalogs all tools. No formal requirements documents, acceptance criteria, or requirements traceability matrix. MCP tool schemas serve as implicit API specs via Zod.
specifications.recommendation: Add lightweight spec templates for new features. Consider a REQUIREMENTS.md or ADR-style format for significant changes. Add acceptance criteria to pm-dashboard task entries.
specifications.riskIfIgnored: Feature scope creep without clear acceptance criteria; ambiguous 'done' definitions

projectDocs.topFinding: CHANGELOG.md tracks all versions (v1.3.0-v2.1.0). Release notes in docs/releases/ document each release thoroughly. pm-dashboard.json serves as institutional memory. Auto-memory in ~/.claude/projects/ preserves cross-session context. No formal ADRs, retrospectives, or decision rationale documents.
projectDocs.recommendation: Add docs/decisions/ directory for Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Document key choices like mcp-shared extraction, runServer() pattern, and testing strategy decisions.
projectDocs.riskIfIgnored: New contributors won't understand why architectural choices were made; repeated debates on settled decisions

progress.topFinding: pm-dashboard.json tracks 25 tasks. Installation manifest (~/.claude/claude-code-helper.json) now tracks installed version + components. /update-check skill lets users verify they're current. sync-version.sh helps maintainers create releases. Version synced to 2.2.0 across package.json and CHANGELOG.
progress.recommendation: Add WIP documentation for in-progress work (current branch, blockers, partial progress). Add estimated completion info to todo tasks.
progress.riskIfIgnored: Agents picking up mid-stream work may duplicate effort or miss context
